sources.note: A330-300P2F N337QT on approach to LAX, 2026-08-04, in Avianca's red scheme with 'avianca cargo' and a small 'Mexico' under it (Avianca Cargo México, the former AeroUnion), not the green Avianca Cargo scheme its sister N338QT wears. Tagged to Avianca's passenger scheme, the nearest drawn: it lacks the 'cargo' title and draws windows.
